name: FoodHub
summary: A comprehensive restaurant management system built with ASP.NET Core 9.0, featuring employee management with role-based access, real-time order tracking, menu management, JWT authentication, Redis caching, and multi-language support.
highlights: Built employee management with role-based authorization (Manager, Chef, Cashier).
Implemented JWT authentication with refresh tokens and CSRF/XSS protection.
Integrated Redis caching, background email jobs, and Cloudinary media management.
Added localization, API versioning, rate limiting, and OpenTelemetry observability.

caseStudy.problem: Restaurants relying on manual processes face challenges in employee coordination, order tracking, and reporting, leading to operational inefficiency and errors.
caseStudy.approach: Developed a full-featured API with ASP.NET Core 9.0 using MediatR for CQRS and Entity Framework Core. Implemented role-based access control, JWT auth with refresh tokens, Redis caching, background jobs for email notifications, and OpenTelemetry for observability.
caseStudy.outcome: A maintainable, secure, and observable restaurant management system with automated health monitoring, comprehensive API versioning, and robust protection against common web attacks.

name: JoyLeeBook
summary: A web-based novel reading platform built with Java Servlet MVC, allowing users to register, browse, read stories online, and authors to submit their work through a dedicated dashboard.
highlights: Browse, search, and read stories online.
Admin panel for comprehensive story management.
Author dashboard for story submission and management.

name: JoyLeeWrite
summary: A desktop application built with C# WPF (.NET 8.0) that provides authors with a distraction-free writing environment featuring rich text formatting, AI integration, and story export as images.
highlights: Built with MVVM architecture using C# and .NET 8.0 WPF.
Rich text formatting and distraction-free writing interface.
AI integration for intelligent writing assistance.
